_doc: Biome 'Verdigris' - palette family + fog for act II (DESIGN.md section 10). Geometry is unaffected (view-layer only, D-048). Roles not listed here (slab side, trim, props, dais, gifts, beacon, ambient, fill light, tripmine particles) inherit from data/palette.json (the Deepwater section 12.2 reference), including the 0.35 emission factor for platform/walkway light. Danger stays red/pink and gold stays gold in every biome (DESIGN.md section 10 rules); the tripmine tells (#FF4FD8 particles, six-pointed star) and the straggler/rim colour (#7CFFF4) never change.
name: Verdigris
